note: Boise NF (Mountain Home RD) dispersed camping around Little Camas Reservoir off US-20 via maintained dirt Forest Rd. Vault toilets at the boat ramp; primitive dispersed sites along the W/N shore flats (respect private-property postings), no potable water, pack-out. First-come, first-served; RVs fit on the flats though larger rigs are limited. --Claude

note: Caribou-Targhee NF (Palisades RD) campground along the banks of Palisades Creek at ~5,900 ft, 7 miles east of Swan Valley then 2 mi NW on gravel Forest Rd 255. 7 drive-in sites (5 single-family, 2 double), gravel roads and parking spurs, picnic tables/campfire rings, vault toilets and drinking water in season; no hookups. First-come, first-served (primitive off-season). ATVs/motorcycles prohibited. Palisades Creek trailhead to Lower/Upper Palisades Lakes starts here. --Claude

note: Sawtooth NF (Fairfield RD) campground along Soldier Creek beside Soldier Mountain Ski Area, ~11 mi north of Fairfield on Forest Rds 094/093. 5 drive-in sites shaded by aspen and cottonwood, RVs allowed up to 30 ft, picnic tables/fire rings, drinking water (after Memorial Day) and vault toilets; no hookups. Individual sites first-come, first-served; the whole campground can be reserved as a group (up to 50). Soldier Creek trail network starts nearby. --Claude

note: Dispersed camping along Nip & Tuck Rd (FR 633) in the Sawtooth NF on the ridge NW of Stanley, with sweeping Sawtooth Range and Stanley views; no water, toilets, or amenities, 10-day max stay, first-come, first-served. Larger RVs limited to the lower, more-level sections off Hwy 21 just past the bridge (a 23-ft rig fits there); upper road is narrow, rutted and off-camber. Do NOT approach from the Hwy 75 (east) end -- a deep wash can damage low-clearance vehicles. --Claude
